sec-general-warnings.title: Warnings — Change bar color when memory is above a certain value

sec-general-high-mem.title: On high memory usage (when memory is above Red threshold)

show-page-file.description: Show page file instead of physical memory
show-page-file.tooltip: Displays Page File (Swap / Commit) usage instead of Physical Memory (RAM) in the taskbar tray icon.

show-free-memory.description: Show free memory instead of memory usage
show-free-memory.tooltip: Displays free available memory instead of used memory in the taskbar tray icon.

show-percentage.description: Show percentage instead of actual value
show-percentage.tooltip: Displays percentage (0-100) instead of GB/MB value in the taskbar tray icon.

btn-open-classic-settings.tooltip: Opens the standalone 5-tab MemInfo Settings dialog.

warn-yellow.tooltip: Change bar color to Yellow when memory usage is above this percentage.

warn-red.tooltip: Change bar color to Red and trigger high memory actions when memory usage is above this percentage.

high-mem-notify.tooltip: Displays a desktop notification when memory usage exceeds the Red warning threshold.

high-mem-log.tooltip: Appends a timestamped high-memory entry to ~/.local/share/memtray/memtray.log.

high-mem-defrag.tooltip: Automatically triggers memory defragmentation / cache cleanup when memory usage exceeds the Red warning threshold.

high-mem-msgbox.tooltip: Shows a modal warning dialog when memory usage exceeds the Red warning threshold.

defrag-periodic.tooltip: Periodically runs the memory defragmenter at the specified interval.

defrag-interval.tooltip: Interval in minutes between automatic memory defragmenter runs.

defrag-hotkey.tooltip: Global keyboard shortcut to trigger Memory Defragmenter.

btn-defrag-now.tooltip: Immediately triggers memory defragmentation and cache reclamation.

refresh-rate.tooltip: Update interval in milliseconds (1000 milliseconds = 1 second).

tray-double-click.tooltip: Action executed when double-clicking the tray icon.

display-off-on-lock.description: Switch off computer's display when workstation is locked
display-off-on-lock.tooltip: Powers off the monitor via DPMS when the Cinnamon screensaver locks the session.

show-tooltip.description: Show current memory information in Icon Tooltip
show-tooltip.tooltip: Shows detailed RAM, Page File, and Top Processes in the tray icon tooltip on hover.

page-file-mode.tooltip: Choose whether Page File represents total Virtual Commit (RAM + Swap, matching Windows MemInfo) or Linux Swap only.

task-manager-cmd.tooltip: Command executed when clicking 'Start Task Manager'.

show-top-processes.tooltip: Displays the list of top memory-consuming processes in the tray popup menu.

top-processes-count.tooltip: Number of top memory-consuming processes to display in the menu.

process-display-mode.tooltip: Format process memory usage as MB/GB value or percentage of physical memory.

highlight-processes.description: Highlight processes with memory value above threshold
highlight-processes.tooltip: Highlights processes whose memory usage exceeds the specified MB threshold.

highlight-threshold-mb.tooltip: Processes using more than this amount of memory (in MB) are highlighted in the menu.

show-process-name.description: Show process name instead of module name
show-process-name.tooltip: Displays the friendly application name instead of the binary/module name.

unify-processes.tooltip: Groups multiple instances of the same process together and displays [count] with summed memory.

show-dashboard.tooltip: Displays Memory Usage %, Physical Memory, and Page File statistics in the tray menu.

show-tray-value-info.description: Show what is the value displayed in tray
show-tray-value-info.tooltip: Displays the header line (e.g. 'Displaying used physical memory') above the dashboard.

use-internal-font.description: Use internal font for optimized results
use-internal-font.tooltip: Uses an optimized built-in compact font for the tray icon text.

custom-font.tooltip: Custom font family and size used when internal font is unchecked.

use-bar-color-for-font.description: Use bar color for font color
use-bar-color-for-font.tooltip: Colors the tray icon text using the active bar status color (Green, Yellow, or Red).

transparent-bg.tooltip: Renders the tray icon with a transparent background instead of filling with 'Icon Tray - Background'.

opaque-bar.tooltip: Renders the memory gauge bar at full opacity.

standard-bar.tooltip: Uses a flat standard progress bar instead of the bordered MemInfo meter style.

bar-at-bottom.tooltip: Places the memory gauge bar horizontally at the bottom of the tray icon instead of vertically on the left.

show-percent-sign.tooltip: Appends '%' when displaying percentage in the tray icon.

theme-preset.tooltip: Select a color theme preset or customize individual Display Items below.

menu-color-mode.tooltip: Color mode for the tray popup menu.

color-menu-highlight.tooltip: Background highlight color for processes exceeding the highlight MB threshold.

color-tray-text.tooltip: Text color in the taskbar tray icon.

color-tray-bg.tooltip: Background color of the taskbar tray icon when 'Transparent background' is unchecked.

color-bar-bg.tooltip: Trough background color of the memory gauge bar.

color-bar-green.tooltip: Bar fill color when memory usage is normal (below Yellow threshold).

color-bar-yellow.tooltip: Bar fill color when memory usage is in warning range (between Yellow and Red thresholds).

color-bar-red.tooltip: Bar fill color when memory usage is critical (at or above Red threshold).
